Name: MXCT3
Function: PHY-side centre tap of pair 3 transformer (pair MX3+ pin 3 / MX3- pin 2; cable contacts 4/5). Datasheet gives no termination for it.

Name: MX3-
Function: PHY-side pair 3 negative (to RJ45 contact 5 MX3-)

Name: MX3+
Function: PHY-side pair 3 positive (to RJ45 contact 4 MX3+)

Name: MX2+
Function: PHY-side pair 2 positive (to RJ45 contact 3 MX2+)

Name: MX2-
Function: PHY-side pair 2 negative (to RJ45 contact 6 MX2-)

Name: MXCT2
Function: PHY-side centre tap of pair 2 transformer (pair MX2+ pin 4 / MX2- pin 5; cable contacts 3/6). Datasheet gives no termination for it.

Name: MXCT4
Function: PHY-side centre tap of pair 4 transformer (pair MX4+ pin 8 / MX4- pin 9; cable contacts 7/8). Datasheet gives no termination for it.

Name: MX4+
Function: PHY-side pair 4 positive (to RJ45 contact 7 MX4+)

Name: MX4-
Function: PHY-side pair 4 negative (to RJ45 contact 8 MX4-)

Name: MX1-
Function: PHY-side pair 1 negative (to RJ45 contact 2 MX1-)

Name: MX1+
Function: PHY-side pair 1 positive (to RJ45 contact 1 MX1+)

Name: MXCT1
Function: PHY-side centre tap of pair 1 transformer (pair MX1+ pin 11 / MX1- pin 10; cable contacts 1/2). Datasheet gives no termination for it.

Name: LED2_GRN_K
Function: Green LED cathode (LED between pins 14 and 13). Datasheet does not say whether this is the left or right LED.

Name: LED2_GRN_A
Function: Green LED anode (LED between pins 14 and 13). Datasheet does not say whether this is the left or right LED.

Name: LED1_GRN_K
Function: Green LED cathode (LED between pins 16 and 15). Datasheet does not say whether this is the left or right LED.

Name: LED1_GRN_A
Function: Green LED anode (LED between pins 16 and 15). Datasheet does not say whether this is the left or right LED.

Name: SHIELD
Function: Metal shield / chassis (two SH pads in the footprint). Internally the four cable-side centre taps go through 75 ohm each to a common node and 1000 pF 2 kV to SHIELD.
